name: Lunar Noise
bio: Lunar Noise is a live vocalist and practicing legal professional based in Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
artist_vibe_summary: Lunar Noise delivers an intimate blend of Indian pop featuring earnest live vocal and acoustic guitar performances that lean toward a neutral, occasionally melancholic emotional tone. While their multi-clip video presence confirms a genuine live instrumentalist capability, technical inconsistencies—ranging from noticeable background distortion to variable recording quality and fluctuating tempos—suggest room for production refinement. Overall, the artist presents an authentic, grassroots musical expression suited best for casual listening or select intimate settings.
